endpoint_derivation.sample: center pixel after deterministic no-noise scanner stages

forbidden: derive black or white endpoints from photographs
clip scan values into the endpoint interval
include stochastic scanner noise in endpoint derivation
fit or alter reversal, scanner, exposure or output parameters
call synthetic endpoints measured scanner calibration
change thresholds after observing the result
promote to stock, calibrated or product rendering

branch_rules.automatic_pass: retain only as a generic scan-to-display normalization primitive and open a separately frozen photographic challenger
branch_rules.automatic_fail: close the endpoint normalization hypothesis without parameter rescue

claim_ceiling: generic endpoint-derived scanner-signal normalization hypothesis; no measured scanner, emulsion, stock, calibration, authenticity, preference or product claim
